title: A mass-summable series of currents: the sum current with mass and support bounds
statement: Assume (VO): for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every U ⊆ ℝ^P, every S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0. Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and X_r ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (r ∈ ℕ) with Σ_r M(X_r) ≠ ∞ (sum in [0, ∞]). Then there is Y ∈ 𝒟_n(U) such that: (i) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) the real series Σ_r X_r(ω) has sum Y(ω) (HasSum); (ii) M(Y) ≤ Σ_r M(X_r); (iii) spt Y ⊆ closure(⋃_r spt X_r). The notions are as follows. 𝒟_n(U) is GeometricCurrentOn U n and 𝒟ⁿ(U) is TestFormOn U n. M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X) is the supremum of ofReal(X(ω)) over ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x. spt X = U ∖ zeroRegion X, where zeroRegion X is the union of the open W with closure W compact, closure W ⊆ U, and X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → ∑' r, (X r).mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, HasSum (fun r => X r ω) (Y ω)) ∧ Y.mass ≤ ∑' r, (X r).mass ∧ Y.support ⊆ closure (⋃ r, (X r).support)
